creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`muster pane send --pane "" <text>` exits 0 and types into whichever pane the window's keyboard is on. In the report that was the caller's own pane; it could as easily be the pane the person is typing in. An explicitly empty REF should be refused; only an absent flag falls back to `$MUSTER_PANE`.

Seen 2026-09-06 (pre-0.8.0, from tooling feedback), when a zsh array off-by-one sent four briefs to the wrong workers. The code is unchanged in 0.15.0: `pane_ref` in `crates/muster-cli/src/args.rs` keeps `Some("")`, unlike `running_in`, which filters empties, and `handler::target` in `crates/muster-seam/src/handler.rs` turns an empty id into `session::focused_pane_on`.

Refusing at parse time (a non-empty value parser) would cover every REF flag at once: `--pane`, `--onto`, `--tab`. Check `msg post --to ""` and the windowless path (`crates/muster-cli/src/windowless.rs`) too.
title: pane send --pane "" types into the window's focused pane
